english.title: Remove another's proceeds of drug trafficking
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) knowing or having reasonable grounds to suspect that property, namely **(..SPECIFY PROPERTY..), was, or in whole or in part directly or indirectly represented, another person's proceeds of drug trafficking, removed from the jurisdiction that property for the purpose of assisting **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to avoid prosecution for a drug trafficking offence or the making or enforcement of a confiscation order
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 49(2) and 54(1) of the Drug Trafficking Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
knowing/have reasonable grounds to suspect property
in whole/part directly/indirectly
represented another person's proceeds of drug trafficking
removed from jurisdiction
property for the purpose of assisting another person
to avoid prosecution for drug trafficking offence or
the making/enforcing of a confiscation order

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
TRANSITIONAL PROVISIONS PERMIT THIS LEGISLATION TO BE USED FOR ANY OFFENCE WHICH STARTED BEFORE ITS REPEAL EVEN IF THE OFFENCE WAS NOT COMPLETE UNTIL AFTER THE 23rd FEBRUARY 2003 (Statutory instrument 2003/120)

(i) See also offence wordings: H1238, H1234, H1236, H1237.
(ii) IMPORTANT - Officers should carefully check an offender's previous convictions. Two prior convictions for a Class 'A' drug trafficking offence may make him/her liable for a minimum sentence of seven years imprisonment under the provisions of section 313 of the Sentencing Act 2020.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Fourteen years imprisonment and / or a fine.

See Note (iii) above re increase in penalty

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
